caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical ceramic jug placed upright against a plain, light beige background. The jug is a stoneware vessel colored in shades of tan and light brown, with blue decorative elements painted on its exterior. Around the upper portion of the jug, near the rounded shoulder below the rim, there are blue brushstroke patterns on either side. On the front, the jug displays a design with the letters "OK" centered at the top in blue, followed by an arrangement of blue dotted patterns above and below the letters. Beneath "OK," there is a motif of two blue, round fruit-like shapes with curved stems and a small leaf, resembling cherries. Below this motif, the word "OHIO" is painted in all capital blue letters, and under that, there is a short, wide, horizontal blue brushstroke. The jug has a wide opening with thick, rounded rim edges and a subtle shading suggesting light falls from the left side. At the lower right corner of the image, the artist's signature is present in small black letters: "FRITZ BOEHMER."
title: Apple Butter Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
